headline: Argentina Parliament Approves Central Bank Reform Law
summary: Argentina's parliament approved a central bank reform law pushed by the government of Javier Milei, which the administration states strengthens the institution's independence.
why: Central bank independence and monetary governance are critical for stabilizing Argentina's inflation and foreign exchange regime.

impacts.name: Argentina
impacts.why: Central bank reforms alter the institutional framework governing monetary policy and inflation.
